snippet.title: PlayCrafter Teaser
snippet.description: PlayCrafter is a website where anyone can create fun flash games using our free online game maker. After you've made a game you can share it with your friends on MySpace, Facebook, your blog or anywhere on the web. Check it out at www.playcrafter.com
